rationale: Copy and Delete already exist in stable v1.82.0 (both source paths are present in that tag). Their omission from the Devices editor's existing Undo/Redo stack is repaired without adding another registry or cross-session history. Existing placement/visual/LED confirmation semantics remain unchanged.

summary.ru: Копирование и удаление устройств можно отменять и повторять вместе с остальными правками редактора, сохраняя настройки и вложения.
summary.en: Device copying and deletion can be undone and redone with other editor changes while retaining settings and attachments.
